batting.name: Ankit Sharma
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b R Ashwin

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b RA Jadeja

batting.name: R Bhatia
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b MM Sharma

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c DH Yagnik b KK Cooper

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b Ankit Sharma

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b Ankit Sharma

balls.text: a full ball outside off, Yagnik hits it towards long off and Faf keeps them to one ... Royals settle for 148 and they will feel they should have got 160
another slower ball and the batsman is beaten as he tries to slog across the line
caught at long off! Bhatia is done by the slower one, he throws his bat at a wider ball outside off and slices it high in the air, Smith runs in from the deep and catches it
Faf shows how it's done! He sprints to his left from long on and dives to field the ball in the nick of time, Bhatia had hammered the ball dead straight
a full ball on the pads, Bhatia flicks and places the ball through the gap between square leg and short fine leg, Shankar chases and dives on the boundary but doesn't save it
a slog outside off stump, the batsman is beaten and Dhoni does not bend low enough to collect, the ball hits his pad and he concedes a bye
a slog sweep to deep square leg, Jadeja ends a superb spell, 2-17
nudged off the front foot through midwicket
a top-edged pull but the ball falls short of deep backward square leg
caught at long-on, the Royal slump continues. Binny simply hit it straight to du Plessis with the bottom of his bat. All very average from Rajasthan
Yagnik jumps back and dabs the ball towards point
bowled him! Faulkner's been done by the quicker, skiddy ball that goes straight on. Faulkner tries to work the ball through square leg but misses, the ball goes off the pad and knocks back leg stump
a slower one, Binny clears his front foot and slugs it towards wide long-on, not timed well
the length is a bit shorter outside off and Faulkner slaps it down to long off
good length and straight once again, Faulkner plays it back to the bowler once again
good length and straight, Faulkner defends on the front foot and Mohit dives to his left to cut it off
what a crazy shot. Smith began to play the scoop, but then saw that the ball was full and straight, and then tried to play some sort of a ramp. He ended up playing nothing and losing leg stump
shot! Smith steps out of his crease, waits for the slower one and lofts it inside out over extra cover, one-bounce four
there's an appeal for a run out after an eventful delivery! Binny survived an lbw appeal and the ball went on the off side, Binny tried to steal a leg bye but was sent back, he made it just in time
shot! Binny steps out of his crease and has room to free his arms, he plays a flowing lofted drive, hitting the ball with the spin over the extra cover boundary
Smith goes back to hit on the leg side but misses, the ball goes off the pad on the off side
Smith aims for a huge reverse slog but is beaten and hit on the pad
driven through cover for a single
Smith steps out but is beaten in the flight, it turns away from him but manages to tap it towards long-on
swept to long leg for one more, that was Ashwin's best over today and he bowled it from over the wicket
Binny tries to reverse sweep this time but is beaten, the ball hits Dhoni and goes on the off side, they steal a run
reverse swept to short third man for a single
steps out of his crease but is not to the pitch of the ball, he nudges it into the gap at deep midwicket and times it slow enough to come back for the second
nudged off the pads towards short fine leg for one more
steps out of his crease and defends on the off side

bowled him! Badree ends his spell with a wicket but Rajasthan won't mind that at all. Nair went back to cut one that was a bit too full and got a bottom edge onto off stump. That will bring in Smith, Faulkner and the rest ...
slog sweeps but does not make proper contact
an overthrow after the batsman plays it close on the off side
Binny steps out, Badree drops it shorter and Binny slogs it over the midwicket boundary
a loud appeal for lbw after the ball skidded on to Binny and hit the pad as he tried to defend, missing leg
punched off the back foot and it beats the diving fielder in the circle
another mid-timed shot, a bottom-edged cut into the ground and towards backward point
in the blockhole around off stump, Nair mis-times it towards midwicket
good length on off and middle, played from the crease towards cover
cut hard off the front foot but can't beat backward point ... where are those jailbreakers Faulkner and Smith? In the dug-out, that's where
steered off the back foot to third man
Binny stays in his crease and opens the face to play the ball to point
Binny tries to play some sort of a dab and gets an edge that misses the stumps and Dhoni, the fielder from fine leg prevents the boundary
good length and angling into the right-hander around off stump, Binny gets an inside edge on to the pad
middle stump has taken a beating! Mohit bowled it full and straight, Watson aimed the slog at the midwicket boundary and missed, that's that. The ball kept a bit low
Mohit follows two awesome slower balls with a rubbish full toss on leg stump, Watson pulls it easily over the backward square leg boundary. That's Watson's fifty and his best score this season
another slower ball outside off stump, Watson mows across the line and is beaten, by a big way
Mohit beats Watson comprehensively outside off stump with a slower one, Watson was through his drive before the ball arrived
defended on the back foot towards the bowler
pushed off the front foot for a single
Watson cuts the ball to short fine leg for a quick single
played to deep square leg for a single

the umpire's signalled that runs! Nair began to play the reverse paddle but then seeing Ashwin was firing it down leg he played the normal paddle, not sure he got any bat on it but the ball beat Dhoni and went to the fine leg boundary
Ashwin bowls a straighter line from round the wicket, Watson turns it off his front pad through square leg
pushed off the front foot to cover
Jadeja turns the ball past the outside edge of Nair's front-foot prod and Dhoni takes off the bails and appeals. The umpire goes to the third umpire but Nair's back foot was grounded

Rahane's been run out! He pushed it off the front foot towards cover and ran. There was no single there but Watson had taken a few steps out of his crease and was late in sending Rahane back. By the time he had turned, Rahane had no chance. McCullum had swooped on the ball and under-armed it back to Dhoni
a flat and short delivery, Watson slaps it towards long off for a single
Watson tries to cut but gets a bottom edge into the ground and on to his pad, the ball was flat and straight from Jadeja, giving the batsman no room
Rahane goes back and nudges a wicket-to-wicket delivery off his pads behind square
Watson wants a drink after sending the ball into the stands at deep midwicket, a length delivery from the debutant and Watson dispatches it with his trademark slogsweep
that's a half-volley on middle and leg, Watson gets on the front foot, gets under it and plays the lofted drive far over the long-on boundary
more width outside off stump, Watson drives to deep cover for two more
a low full toss outside off but Watson has width to use, he drives it hard off the front foot and once it beats the man in the circle at cover it's a four
driven off the back foot through cover for a single
Rahane gets beaten while trying to whip a good length ball on the leg side
punched off the back foot towards long-on, the fielder from midwicket - McCullum I think - dives across to cut it off
moves forward and outside off to drive through cover
slowed it up, on off and middle, Rahane plays it back to the bowler
bowled flat and quick outside off, Watson goes back and cuts to short third man
nudged off the front foot towards mid-on, Jadeja chases it all the way to the edge of the circle
cut off the back foot to deep point
played off the pads towards square leg

caught at long-on! Ankit slogged an offbreak from outside off stump and for the awkward way he made contact he hit it pretty far, Dwayne Smith was right on the edge of the boundary when he took the catch
another tremendous wide down leg, Watson tries to sweep for a third time but the ball is too far away, the ball thuds off Dhoni's pads ...
another huge wide outside leg stump, Watson connects with the sweep this time, hitting it wide of the fielder at short fine leg
that's a huge wide outside leg stump, Watson tried to sweep but missed
a fuller length around off, Ankit hits the ball hard, he was aiming leg side but it went towards long off
Watson steps out to take the ball on the full and drives to long on
slows it up outside off stump from round the wicket, Ankit stays back and pushes the ball in front of point
Watson drives the ball with power along the ground this time, giving Mohit Sharma a challenging save to make at long off, he runs to his right and picks up quite cleanly
Ankit mis-times a pull towards square leg, the length was not short enough
Watson blasts the ball flat and hard back at the bowler, Pandey gets fingertips on it and saves a  boundary, the ball still goes down towards long on
Watson mis-times a pull to the man in the circle at midwicket
this time he does beat point, drilling a full and wide ball in front of point with a powerful square drive
good length around off, Watson cuts but can't beat point
that's a huge hit! The left-hander is countering Ashwin's line from round the wicket. Ankit waits for the ball angling into him and then slog sweeps into the stands beyond midwicket
defended on the front foot towards point
Ashwin fires the ball down leg side, Ankit glances it between the keeper and short fine leg for another boundary
Ankit slogs the ball angling into him from round the wicket, he mis-timed it but hit it well enough to clear mid-on and reach the boundary
Ankit moves back and pulls the ball to deep midwicket, Watson has to hurry back for the second, the outfield is fast and the ball got to the fielder quickly
pitches outside leg from round the wicket, the ball skids on to hit Watson's pad
Ankit cuts a shorter ball hard off the back foot but does not beat point
Ankit gets on to the front foot and dabs on the off side
that's been chipped in the air but it is wide of the man at midwicket
a fuller ball on middle, Watson plants his foot forward and drives hard, but can't beat midwicket
bowled flat and fast on a good length around off stump, Watson stays back and plays to point
defended on the front foot on the off side
a good length ball outside off, Ankit aims for a huge slog across the line but is beaten, the ball thuds off Dhoni's pads and goes towards short fine leg
defended from the crease towards the bowler

shot! Ankit Sharma stays on the back foot and punches a good length ball angling into him with a straight bat, he finds the gap between extra cover and mid-off and the timing is good enough to beat du Plessis' pursuit
that's a length ball with width outside off, Sharma stands in his crease and slams it flat over the outstretched arm of the leaping fielder at mid-off, it was du Plessis in that position
Sharma tries to drive a fuller ball down the ground but his timing is completely off, Watson sets off for a single but Sharma sends him back, it went straight to the fielder at mid-on
good length around off stump, Sharma stays in his crease and plays a tame push to cover
nudged off the pads in front of square for a single
bowled flat and fast outside off stump, angling across the left-hander, Sharma is beaten on the cut
worked off the pads on the back foot through midwicket
that's a poor ball, bowled full and quick down leg side, Watson misses the glance and Dhoni can't collect it either
a wristy drive to wide long-on off the front foot
Sharma aims a slog sweep over deep midwicket but misses, the ball goes to slip off the pad
pulled off the back foot to square leg, a mis-timed shot
Watson has spoiled an outstanding opening over from Pandey by pulling the length ball over the wide long-on boundary, it just cleared the rope
Watson tries to cudgel a good length ball through midwicket but mis-times it towards mid-off
defended from the crease with a straight bat
good length outside off stump, cut off the front foot to point
the extra bounce from short of a length outside off surprises Watson, who begins to push at the ball and then pulls out of the shot
cut really hard off the front foot, Jadeja dives to his right at point and saves a boundary
driven on the front foot to long-on, there's a fielder in the deep
nudged off the front foot through midwicket for a single
another quick skiddy ball outside off stump, Sharma goes back to cut but is beaten
defended back to the bowler
Sharma goes back to pull but is beaten by a skiddy ball and is hit on the pad, an appeal for lbw from Dhoni but it pitched outside leg
pitches on leg stump and skids on, Sharma goes back and defends

CSK have done it! Royals fall to pieces off that delivery. Dhoni pushed the ball through cover again and Cooper was slow in coming off the boundary, they were going to complete the second to level the scores. Cooper threw to Faulkner who was sloppy in collecting the throw ... they conceded the overthrow ... CSK go to the top of the league with two balls to spare.
a wide full toss outside off stump, Dhoni reaches out and hits it to Cooper at deep cover, there's some serious running going on, two more ... CSK so close now
Dhoni's smashed it! He's dragged the full ball from outside off stump and whacked it flat over the wide long-on boundary, there you go
a length ball outside off, Jadeja cuts but can't beat point, Ankit Sharma fields
a sensational yorker from Cooper but Dhoni manages to dig it out towards midwicket, the fielder is in the deep so there's no danger in taking two this time
Has Dhoni been run out this time? Dhoni thundered back for the second after inside-edging a slog to deep square leg, the throw hit direct but Dhoni's stretch took him home. It was a close call!
Jadeja tries to work the ball on the leg side but gets an bottom edge past the stumps to the keeper, Dhoni sprints through for the single
wham! Jadeja's sent the ball flying over long off, that has been a long time coming for CSK. He jumps down the track to get to the pitch of the ball and swings hard, making superb contact
has Jadeja been run out? Tambe hits the stumps direct from short fine leg but Jadeja is super quick and safe. Cooper had delivered the yorker and Dhoni dug it out via an inside edge to short fine leg
a slower ball on a good length, Jadeja checks his shot and chips the ball through cover
Jadeja dabs the length ball to short third man to keep strike
a slower ball on a good length outside off, Dhoni was on the back foot, perhaps waiting to wind up, but he ended up dabbing it towards point
Jadeja moves forward and across to turn a full ball in front of square leg
in the blockhole, bowled him! Full and straight, and fast too. Faf was outside leg, making room to hit through the off side. He missed and the ball crashed into the base of middle sump
Faulkner sprays a second wide far outside off, he's trying to get Faf to lunge for it on a bad leg

a length ball and Dhoni swipes it down the ground to Steven Smith at long on, Faf turns to come back for the second but Dhoni doesn't want it, Faf goes scrambling back on a bad leg and dives to make his crease at the striker's end
Faulkner sprays the ball wide outside off from over the wicket, that's a wide
Faf steps out of his crease and mis-times the loft towards long-on, Smith runs in and fields
worked off the back foot in front of square leg ...
a poor ball, full and down leg, Cooper is lucky to escape with that, Dhoni glances it to short fine leg
Cooper spears in a yorker and smacks Faf on the base of the pad, that was missing leg, Cooper can't believe he doesn't have an lbw
a slower ball short of a length, Faf pulls too early and is beaten
well done Watto, cuts off a firm drive from Dhoni at cover, good stop
Faf stays back, taps the ball towards point and takes the single, he's hobbling but he isn't hesitating
a terrible finish from Tambe, he had bowled so beautifully by not trying too much but now he fires a ball fast down leg side, Dhoni paddles and gets some bat on it to beat the keeper
tossed up on a fuller length, played back to the bowler
Dhoni stays back and mis-times a shot into the covers, Tambe bowled it flat and straight
Faf steps out and hits the ball to long off for a single
that's too short and it kept low, Dhoni stayed back and nudged off his pads behind square
Dhoni was on the back foot and squared up by a legbreak that pitched middle and spun past off

Dhoni nudges the ball close on the leg side and runs, Faf has an injured leg but he responds, the keeper fields and throws at the bowler's end but misses, Dhoni turns around for the overthrow but spares Faf the strain
bowled him with an uber slow ball, Ashwin made room outside leg and slogged across the line, he was through the shot too early and leg stump took a hit
played to long on for a single
steps out of his crease and slaps a length ball through cover, Ashwin sprints back for the second, Faf hobbles, it's roughly the same speed for both
Ashwin stays in his crease and mis-times the ball towards cover where Watson fails to prevent the single
a length, slower ball outside off, Faf stays back and drives to long off
driven to long off for a single, and the game will break for important strategies to be discussed during the time out
backs away outside leg to make room, Faulkner follows him with a slower ball, the batsman dabs but can't beat short third man
Faf moves back and across and flicks the length ball through square leg
Ashwin lofts it down to long on but mis-times it, the ball falls short of Smith in the deep
nudged off the pads from the crease to square leg
a slower ball outside off, from the back of the hand, played from the crease to cover
taken on the full and driven to deep cover, productive over for CSK
worked off the pads through midwicket and Faf has hit it gently enough to run two, though Ashwin has to dive at the bowler's end to make it
Ashwin moves across his crease and taps the ball softly into the leg side for a single towards midwicket
superb placement! Ashwin gets down on one knee and slog sweeps the ball into the gap on the cow corner boundary
in the blockhole and Ashwin plays it to midwicket, Faf had come a long way out of his crease and had to hurry back
Ashwin tries to drive through cover but mis-times it because it's a slower variation of a slower ball
Ashwin steps out and nudges the ball very close on the leg side, the bowler should have cut that off
Faf comes out and drops the ball close on the leg side for a single
bowled flat and fast and straight, Ashwin stays back and dabs the ball towards cover
Ashwin steps out to take the ball on the full and drives it wide of long-on, placing it well enough to come back for two even though the fielder is Steven Smith
driven to long on for a single
steps out of his crease and drives calmly to long-off
moves across and plays the ball to long on for a single
Ashwin moves across his crease and tries to play the ball square by closing the face, the leading edge nearly carried to Bhatia
good length around off with a slow ball, Ashwin defends on the front foot to cover
a very slow ball on middle and off, Faf bunts it through midwicket for a single
full and straight, Ashwin gets off the mark by pushing the ball to long on
a length ball outside off, punched from the crease to long off
caught behind! Cooper strikes with the slower ball that was pitched short of a length! Smith was on the pull way too early and the top edge lobbed tamely to the keeper. Yagnik ran forward to take it
Smith flays his bat at a length ball outside off and is beaten
short ball wide outside off, Faf drags it with the pull and hits it in front of square
good length just outside off, Faf defends on the off side and Cooper runs across towards short cover to field and prevent the single
in the blockhole but Smith digs it out on the off side and runs
Smith slogs across the line at a slower ball outside off and is beaten
short third man dives over the ball after Faf makes good contact with a ramp that goes between the keeper and the fielder, the ball rolls on to the rope before fine leg can get to it
steps out of his crease but is beaten in the length and hit on the pads, Tambe appeals for lbw but the batsman was too far down the pitch
Faf plays a cheeky little scoop over the keeper, didn't time it well at all
Faf jumps out of his crease, Tambe tries to beat him down leg side but Faf manages to flick it through midwicket
tossed up on middle, Smith drives firmly to long on
bowled full and straight, Faf moves forward and clips it through midwicket
that's a bottom edge and the ball has scooted between the keeper's legs for a boundary. That is not a chance. Smith slogged across the line and got a bottom edge from wide outside off stump
full length outside off, driven on the front foot along the ground for a single
defended from the crease towards Watson at cover
played through midwicket for a single
another slower ball but it's short and outside off, Smith goes back and uses his brawn to mow the ball wide of the fielder at long-on
the slower one drifts down leg side, Yagnik lunges to collect and then lunges back to break the stumps, nicely done
a full ball on off stump, played on to the leg side for a single
defended back to the bowler on the front foot, Ankit finishes four overs on the trot - 2 for 20. Top spell
Faf stands outside leg to make room and then hits a flat one through cover
fired down leg side, Smith tries to paddle the ball but misses and is hit on the leg
Faf goes right back and taps the ball through midwicket for a single
played off the back foot towards long on for a single
pitches on middle and turns across Smith, who goes back and dabs towards the bowler
a slower one on middle stump, Smith stays back and nudges in front of square for a single
nearly in the blockhole, Smith plays it out towards square leg
glanced to short fine leg for a single
Du Plesiss moves forward and across to glance to fine leg but misses, that was close to leg stump
tremendous response! Du Plessis steps out of his crease and drives a full ball with a wonderfully straight bat right past the bowler

he's bowled him! Cooper begins to celebrate but then realises the ball hasn't dislodged a bail. Faf defended a length ball but it hit the bottom of his bat and bounced on the pitch and rolled on to the stumps, the impact was too soft
Smith works the ball off his pads to square leg
played to deep midwicket for a single
played back to the bowler after coming out of the crease
a strong appeal for lbw after Faf tries to defend on the front foot but the umpire says there was an inside edge on to pad. He was right

that's a poor ball but Raina's swept it straight to short fine leg! Ankit pitched on leg from round the wicket and it was an ordinary delivery. Raina moved across his stumps, got down on one knee and swept. He didn't hit it high enough but a couple of feet either side of the fielder at short fine and it would have been four. However, the ball went straight to Bhatia, who took a low catch
pushed off the back foot towards midwicket for a single, Ankit's pushing them through flat and straight
driven to long-on for a single
Yagnik thinks he has caught Smith down the leg side as he tried to swat the ball but the umpire calls it wide
played on the back foot on the off side
Raina moves back and across and punches the ball to long-on
Smith hits it to long-off again, but along the ground this time because the fielder is in the deep
mid-off is in the circle so Smith simply gets on to the front foot and lofts the ball with a straight bat over that fielder, one-bounce four to long off
too short and there's width outside off, Smith goes back in his crease and plays a correct back-foot drive that beats mid-off
played off the back foot towards midwicket
strays on to the pads and Smith goes back and works it behind square, Tambe gives chase on a fast outfield and dives to save the boundary
that's a long hop, too easy for Smith who nonchalantly pulls to deep midwicket for a one-bounce four
a flat ball on the pads, Smith dabs it towards square leg and wants one, Raina sends him back
nudged off the front foot towards long on for a single
a superb catch! McCullum hit that slog sweep hard, sending the ball flat and fast towards square leg where Karun Nair caught it at head height. The ball went straight to him but it was travelling
a bit too close to cut, Smith tries to and gets a bottom edge into the ground towards the keeper
Smith mows across the line at a slower ball wide outside off stump, he doesn't make contact
a slower ball wide outside off stump, Smith mis-times it on the off side
Smith wants to make light work of this target! He's on the front foot as he lofts a length ball through the line and over long-off this time
defended into the off side
shot! That's too full and a bit straight, Smith gets on the front foot and plays a checked, short-arm, lofted straight drive clean over the boundary
that's a wide outside off, slanting across the right-hander, Smith slashes and misses
McCullum ruins Anikt's over by charging down the pitch and lofting cleanly through the line to hit the ball over the long-on boundary
bowled flat on middle stump, McCullum stays back and closes the face to play to square leg, he wants one, Smith does not
nudged to midwicket for a single
a skiddy ball that hits Smith on the back foot deep in his crease, that was missing leg
a straighter line on the pads, Smith goes back to play on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pad
pitches on a good length and turns away from the right-hander, Smith defends on the front foot
